node.title: Nonzero affine reflections leave 255011043 records on other synchronized pencil classes
node.closure: first-owner summation of the exact 1154 fixed-pencil cap after per-pair exchange synchronization
node.statement: The triple-owner heavy-ruling family has at least 322359637 records on at most 58361 first-owned pair types. Apply multi-anchor exchange. Either one admissible packet has chi>=2299571, or every type with at least 29 records owns one synchronized rational pencil. A type whose pencil is a normalized nonzero affine reflection owns at most 1154 records by the exact official census; a smaller unsynchronized type owns at most 28 and may be pessimistically charged the same 1154. Thus all small or nonzero-affine types own at most 58361*1154=67348594 records. At least 255011043 records remain on synchronized rational pencils outside that class, so one such pair type owns at least 4370 records. No residual class or high-complexity output is paid.
